summary.text: A 41-year-old woman underwent breast conserving surgery and axillary dissection in February 2002; pathology showed pT2N2M0 stage IIIA luminal-HER2 type breast cancer. She received postoperative chemotherapy with 5-fulorouracil, epirubicin and cyclophosphamide, then LHRH-a, tamoxifen and tegafur plus uracil after chemotherapy and whole-breast radiotherapy.

Four years after surgery, during adjuvant systemic therapy, she had recurrence in multiple supraclavicular lymph nodes. First-line treatment for metastatic breast cancer was started with paclitaxel and trastuzumab, and after 4 cycles she had a complete radiological response with non-pathological CEA and CA15-3.

She remained in clinical complete response during 5 years of maintenance trastuzumab and then terminated systemic therapy. The last follow up was August 2018, and she had survived after termination of anti-HER2 therapy.

article_limitations: Table 1 reports a 45-patient HER2-positive cohort that does not individuate the four cases; it is treated as aggregate and no facts were taken from it. Its n of 45 differs from the 40 plus 5 patients in the Methods text; not reconciled.
Caption-layer visual status not_inspected in this annotation; the five images are reviewed in visual.json.
Case 2 subtype wording conflicts between the case text and the Fig. 2 caption; both sides are review_only and the subtype is kept out of labels and summaries.
Case 1 printed survival of 11.5 years after termination of anti-HER2 therapy does not match the dates and durations in its own paragraph; kept review_only.

Discussion sentences about "all patients" (tapering, small tumor volume, asymptomatic, 1 to 2 metastatic sites, maintenance for 1 to 4 years) are not literally attributed to the four cases; tapering is review_only per patient and the others were not extracted.
Fig. 4 caption lists a panel C that is not on the image bound to Fig. 4; the same text is the Fig. 5 caption, whose image shows the tapering schematic.
Supplements: none listed in the source. Figure images are not downloaded as part of source.json; pixel review is in visual.json.
Several results are described only as "non-pathological values" (CEA, CA15-3, NCC-ST-439); recorded as normal without numeric values.

Fig. 4 and Fig. 5 are not an asset swap: gr4 shows the panels A and B the Fig. 4 caption describes, and the Fig. 4 caption's panel C text is printed again as the Fig. 5 caption, whose image gr5 shows the tapering schematic; panel C appears to have been published as a separate figure.

Source typos kept literally in quotes: "5-fulorouracil", "trastzumab" (Introduction), "surgical recession" (Fig. 3 caption, labelled as resection), "11.5 year", "a non-pathological values", "HER 3+" and "Ope" in the Fig. 1 caption legend versus "Op" on the image.

Table 1 internal inconsistencies (aggregate, not extracted): the HER2 2+ FISH-amplified percentage 6 (3.3) does not match 6 of 45, and the visceral metastasis counts for all patients (51, 76, 40, 4) sum to 171, not 45.
